posts.text: My husband and I are doing all the work ourselves because that's all we can afford. We even get free or discounted materials from construction waste when available. When I can afford an EV, I'll buy one. Nothing you say will change that. My finances just aren't there yet!
posts.summary: Will transition to EV when finances allow, prioritizes affordability over immediate adoption

posts.text:
You want to pay for my all my home's repairs? Because that's what's holding me back from being able to afford going electric (and solar).

I also own an e-bike and use it whenever possible, so I'm not really worried about the little bit I drive my gasoline car. I'll go electric when I can afford it.

posts.text: There are a grand total of 10 public chargers in my city of 75,000. The bus system doesn't even run after 6 PM either. I do have a protected bike lane in my neighborhood, but it drops you off at the most dangerous intersection for cyclists in the entire city. At least some streets have sidewalks!
